SHARED FILES, SEPARATE WORKSPACES

Reuse the asset.
Keep the project yours.

A single plugin checkout can feed multiple linked UE 5.8 projects. Each project gets its own catalog and collections, while shared UAssets live in one plugin Content mount.

TWO WAYS TO ADD AN UNREAL ASSET

Register in place.
Share when ready.

Asset paths tell the archive what to show. They do not silently move your original files.

EXISTING PROJECT ASSETNO COPY

Keep an existing UAsset where it is.

Use preview_assets to reference a mesh, texture, or material already in this project's /Game/ content.

/Game/YourMesh→Catalog reference
A /Game path stays project-local.
CROSS-PROJECT SHARINGONE IMPORT

Put a shared preview in plugin Content.

Import a new FBX once into the shared plugin mount. Linked UE projects can reference the same package path.

FBX→/BlackLionAssetArchive/SharedAssets
Existing /Game assets are not migrated automatically.
BUILT FOR A HUMAN + AI 3D TEAM

Give the agent
the right map.

The AI reads project identity and the current TODOs, writes one manifest, then runs a local sync command. No image-by-image API inspection is needed for routine catalog updates.

✓
Project guardUnique project_id prevents cross-project mixing.
✓
Duplicate guardStable IDs and FBX receipts stop silent replacement.
✓
Review boundarySync success is not art approval or in-game validation.
Read the AI team contract ↗
archive_item.json
{
  "schema": "blacklion.asset-archive.item.v1",
  "id": "relay_housing_v1",
  "project_id": "studio_game_alpha",
  "name": "Relay Housing",
  "kind": "object",
  "preview_assets": [
    "/Game/Factory/SM_RelayHousing.SM_RelayHousing"
  ],
  "todos": ["Check floor contact in archive"],
  "pbr_channels": ["base_color", "normal"]
}

GET A TEAM ARCHIVE RUNNING

Start with one
shared checkout.

Install the same source once, link each project, and create a separate identity file for each game. The current setup helper targets Windows and UE 5.8.

01

Clone the plugin

Choose a stable team folder that every participating project can reach.

git clone github.com/delight0517/ue-asset-atlas
02

Link a project

Preview, then apply the junction while the target editor is closed.

link_shared_plugin.ps1 -ProjectFile Game.uproject -Apply
03

Give the AI its brief

Set the project ID, axes, approved paths, IDs, source links, and TODOs.

AssetArchive_Inbox/project.json
04

Sync and review

Run the commandlet sync and open the archive map in Unreal to review.

sync_archive_project.ps1 -ProjectFile Game.uproject
i

Keep the scope honest. This release is source code plus setup tools, not a ready-made project map or an AI connection. AI agents need their own approved local access and the team sync command.
